violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -The pizza prep table on the vegetable side has a build up on the back of the lid/hinge.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Attachments to walls and ceilings (e.g. light fixtures, vent covers, decorations etc..) were not cleanable and/or maintained in good repair. -The fan guards for the walk-in cooler have a build up of dust and require cleaning. -Two separate ceiling vents, one in front of the walk-in freezer door and one over the three sink system, are dusty and in need of cleaning.

Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying. -The kitchen mop is not in a position to allow proper air drying.

Preventing contamination by employees. — --Employee observed using same pair of single-use gloves for more than one task.* Exchange gloves between tasks and prior to handling food and food contact surfaces.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. *The bottom shelf of the prep table and the single door freezer by the prep table had food crumb accumulation on the bottom shelf. Maintain cleanliness in all areas.
Proper storage, labeling, use (3 pts deducted)
